name: lib/retry
title: Retry backoff
summary: How long to wait before retry n: exponential, capped, jittered; the random draw is passed in.

config.name: base_ms
config.description: The delay before the first retry.

config.name: max_ms
config.description: The longest delay; at least base_ms.

operations.description: The settings, or why they are invalid.
The wait before retry number retry (1 is the first), given a draw in [0, 1).

invariants.text: The delay grows by factor and stops at max_ms.
Jitter never makes a delay exceed max_ms, for any draw (NaN and out-of-range included).
Equal jitter never waits less than half the delay.
Huge retry counts do not overflow.
Invalid settings and zero attempts are refused.
